messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (sev=high) — multi-GPU serving job job-2134 reporting repeated communicator timeouts and container restarts on node gpu-node-45. Affected tenant: tenant-acme. Root ts: 1764201123

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. pulling recent logs from job-2134 now. tagging @sre-maria for follow up.

sre-maria: oncall-ack. quick question — is this steady-state inference or a training batch?

oncall-ryan: steady-state online inference, pipeline-parallel model (tp=2, pp=2). latency spikes to 10-20s just before timeouts.

infra-paul: I see node-level flaps in the last 8 minutes: kernel dmesg shows repeated GPU resets on GPU1. Example: `Xid 79` and then `GPU hung` followed by container oom kill.

alex-eng: logs from app side show NCCL communicator errors right before the crash:```
2026-02-25T14:31:58Z ERROR nccl: unhandled cuda error 77 at collective.c:423
2026-02-25T14:31:59Z WARN runtime: kv-cache flush incomplete
2026-02-25T14:32:00Z ERROR container: exit status 137
```

devops-bot: Auto-scaler noticed increased restart_count for job-2134 pods (3 -> 7 in 6m). Marked pool gpu-pool-2 as degraded.

oncall-ryan: action plan proposal: 1) cordon gpu-node-45 2) drain pods 3) re-route job-2134 to spare pool gpu-pool-hot 4) enable smaller model fallback (model-2134-lite) as temporary mitigation. If node continues flapping, escalate to hardware.

sre-maria: agree. adding step 0 — capture full nvml+nccl logs and kcoredumps before draining. run `kubectl logs --since=15m` and `nvidia-smi --query` snapshots.

infra-paul: copying the nvml dump now. Also pinging cloud-provider for NVLink error rates on that host.

oncall-ryan: running drain: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-45 && kubectl drain gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force```

alex-eng: while pods reschedule, enable fallback: ```POST /v1/jobs/job-2134/actions HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{ "action": "switch_model", "model": "model-2134-lite", "reason": "node-flap mitigation" }```

customer-success-kate: I notified tenant-acme that they may see degraded throughput and potential ephemeral errors for ~10-20min while we reschedule. They asked if stateful contexts are at risk — answered: no state loss, only transient latency.

devops-bot: Rebalance underway — 4 pods rescheduled to gpu-pool-hot. Health checks failing on 1/4 currently (tcp probe failing).

infra-paul: cloud-provider reports NIC interface flaps correlated with GPU resets — opening hardware ticket. Possible fabric issue between GPUs (NVSwitch/NVLink).

sre-maria: monitoring NCCL errors post-reschedule. Early signs: error rate dropped after moving off node-45. Still seeing occasional `NCCL WARN: incomplete rendezvous` on the migrated pods (maybe stale communicator metadata).

oncall-ryan: I forced a communicator resync on the running worker by restarting the process gracefully: `kill -SIGUSR1 <pid>` for warm restart (our handler flushes KV cache then reconnects NCCL). Confirmed reconnects succeeded for 3/4 workers.

alex-eng: note — if communicator IDs differ because underlying pod IP changed, the runtime should re-negotiate. We should add better logging to detect stale ranks earlier. Filing a follow-up perf task.

devops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-845. Bridge: https://zoom.internal/bridge/INC-2026-845. Pager duty: ryan -> oncall escalation policy applied.

customer-success-kate: tenant-acme acknowledged and will monitor. They reported one failed inference (400) during the window, but no downstream errors.

infra-paul: hardware team scheduled a deep-dive and will run memtest and NVLink loopback on gpu-node-45 this evening. For now node remains cordoned.

sre-maria: marking mitigation as successful for immediate customer impact — throughput back to baseline for tenant-acme using model-2134-lite. Setting 30m monitoring window; if errors recur we escalate to SEV-crit.

oncall-ryan: logging post-incident actions: 1) add communicator resync on soft restarts to playbook, 2) add probe for NVLink error counters to node exporter, 3) add automated fallback to lite model on repeated NCCL errors.

alex-eng: pushed a small change to runtime to surface the communicator id mismatch in logs (PR #4601).

devops-bot: Auto-heal note: gpu-pool-hot has 2 spare nodes remaining. No quota breaches.

incident-bot: Summary: root cause suspected hardware-level GPU resets causing NCCL communicator failures and container OOM cascades. Mitigation: cordon+drain of affected node, reschedule to spare pool, enable lightweight model fallback, communicator resync. Next steps: hardware triage, telemetry improvements, playbook updates.

sre-maria: I'll own the postmortem. tagging @infra-paul for hardware follow-up and @alex-eng for runtime logging. If no new errors in 30m I'll close the page. :white_check_mark:
